name: Test: primitives through the game's DrawGeometry (C#)
author: test
summary: Proof for GraphicsDevice primitives: mod-made vertices drawn by the game's DrawGeometry with no effect, a vanilla MiscShaderData and a mod .fxc pass.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csprimpoc. Effects/SpriteFx.fxc is the csspritefx one. Logs 'csprimpoc draw <case> x,y,w,h screen WxH', 'csprimpoc <case>: ok | FAIL' and 'csprimpoc END pass=N fail=M'; the strips stay on screen for a screenshot.
